entities.title: Prims Desktop
entities.description: Local-first macOS Prims environment. Product decisions are recorded in this prim.product graph.

entities.title: One Prims Desktop installation can use multiple Prims profiles

provenance.method: stated directly in product design thread, 2026-08-27

entities.description: A person can have different Prims profiles rather than one global Prims environment.

entities.title: A setup file under ~/prims points to the profile's default Prims folder

provenance.method: stated directly in product design thread, 2026-08-27

entities.description: Prims Desktop keeps a small machine-local setup/bootstrap file under ~/prims. It points to the default Prims folder for the selected profile instead of making the app installation itself the data store.

entities.title: Each profile owns its own folder on a drive

provenance.method: stated directly in product design thread, 2026-08-27

entities.description: Each Prims profile has its own filesystem folder, and that folder stores all settings and Prims for that profile. Different profiles may point to different folders or drives.

entities.title: Profiles are separate Prims worlds

provenance.method: direct implication of Daniel's stamped profile/storage decisions

entities.description: Switching profiles changes the profile-specific settings and Prims because those live under the selected profile root.

entities.title: Exact ~/prims bootstrap filename and schema are not yet locked

provenance.method: not specified in Daniel's 2026-08-27 profile decision

entities.description: The product decision establishes the bootstrap location and role, but not its exact filename, encoding, or serialized schema.

events.detail: Created Prims Desktop prim.product pack and recorded the stamped profiles/storage model.
Daniel stamped multiple profiles, a ~/prims bootstrap pointer, and one filesystem root per profile containing that profile's settings and Prims.
